about: Defects planted one at a time, to show the visual comparison and the gallery see them (tools/visual-baseline/plants.mjs). The review's (slice-review2, 1c and plant.mjs: 0 to 12) written against the code as it is now, and the parts-on-every-surface ones (13 to 15). Each is applied to the test build only, by vite.config.ts (HS_SWITCH); one that no longer applies fails the run. 12 is behaviour, not looks: the switches check ('knob keys') catches it.

switches.feature: plant-00 wrong class on the LCD picker wrapper
plant-01 pedal selectors without their .psels wrapper
plant-02 a pedal's hue off by 10
plant-03 a knob's read-out before its label
plant-04 the LED button never marked changed
plant-05 the knob never marked changed
plant-06 a knob's role a button, and junk ARIA
plant-07 a segmented choice never says which is pressed
plant-08 a side unit's power says the opposite
plant-09 a pedal knob prints its full label
plant-10 the tier button's tooltip names the wrong key (same length)
plant-13 the meter's look off the board dropped
plant-14 the shared changed mark dropped
plant-15 the LED button on paper left as the rack's slab
switches.find: background: var(--raised); border-color: var(--line); color: var(--muted); }
